title.narrative: Provision of emergency lifesaving nutrition services for the drought and AWD affected populations in rural villages in Bay region.

description.narrative:
ltpgtltfont color="#000000" face="Arial, sans-serif"gtDue to limited access to essential basic services, population in Berdale, particularly rural villages remains under-served. Children, pregnant and lactating mothers face unimaginable challenges such as acute malnutrition, child mortality, and maternal mortality. SAMA proposes this life saving emergency nutrition project which aims to sustain essential nutrition services for the drought affected vulnerable populations Berdale and surrounding villages. The project will be implemented through facility based (2 fixed sites) and 2 mobile approach that will cover 10 worst affected locations by AWD and drought conditions. Each of the mobile facilities will cover populations in 5 sub villages targeting a total of 15,000 drought affected with equal access to (girls, boys, women and men. The project will be implemented in complementary of current ongoing health and nutrition projects run by SAMA and in close collaboration and coordination with health and nutrition cluster partners as well as WASH cluster and Ministry of health. lt/fontgtlt/pgtltpgtltspan style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0) font-family: Arial, sans-serif"gtSAMA has active PCA with UNICEF and will have access to nutrition and health supplies which will complement to the project resources.lt/spangtltbrgtlt/pgtltpgtltfont color="#000000" face="Arial, sans-serif"gtNutrition interventions. ltbrgt SAMA will recruit 40 Community Health Workers (CHW) to strength community structures/ system for health and nutrition promotion.
